title: Brickwork & Blockwork
activity: Brick and block walls, ties, DPCs, movement joints
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Is there an approved sample panel / benchmark for this wall type?
Line, level and plumb within tolerance: straightness ±5 mm in 5 m, verticality ±10 mm to 3 m?
questions.source: SBC ITP – construct walls (NHBC/ spec tolerances)

questions.q: Are cavities clean, wall ties at the specified spacing and clean, insulation tight?
Are DPCs, cavity trays and lintels in place with correct laps and stop ends?
Movement joints at the specified spacing, with the correct sealant?
Head restraints fitted, and mortar laid at 5°C or above?
